svg.aria-label: AI works because mathematics does. A cloud of points resolves into a human pose, triangulated by two cameras, then dissolves again.
svg.text: Pradeep Rajasekar, also Ajish Pradeep. AI Research Engineer, Taipei.
Human pose in 3D, on a phone. Retail vision at 7,000 stores. LLMs that never do the maths.
Fig. 1 420 points finding a body: two consumer cameras, 29 keypoints, and the club the product needed. Drawn live at ajishpradeep.com.
